regions.region: left column, conclusion continuation and Experimental Section: General Procedure for Asymmetric Propargylation
regions.finding: The conclusion continuation introduces no new experiment. The General Procedure was visually read and merged into the 29 existing Table 4 scope experiments as cross-page evidence: low-temperature addition under argon at -60 °C, 8 h hold, saturated NH4Cl quench, three Et2O extractions, brine wash, Na2SO4 drying, solvent removal, silica-gel flash chromatography with petroleum ether/ethyl acetate 9:1, chiral GC-or-HPLC enantiopurity measurement, and optical-rotation-based absolute-configuration assignment. It was not duplicated as a new reaction record.

regions.region: left column, Acknowledgements and References [1]-[4]; right column, References [4]-[16]
regions.finding: Acknowledgements and bibliography entries are non-experimental context. Cited literature was not converted into current-paper reactions, and no independent mass-spectrum peak table, molecular-weight list, or fragment-abundance observation appears.

unresolved: Table 4 gives a nominal 0.5 mmol scale, while the page-7 General Procedure gives 0.47 mmol aldehyde; both values are retained as an evidence-linked conflict without choosing one.
The 9.4 mmol scale-up does not report scale-specific reaction-solvent or workup volumes; small-scale volumes were not multiplied or copied.
For 3aa, Table 4 replaces DCM with EtCN, so page-7 DCM portion volumes were not copied; the experiment-specific EtCN volume remains unreported.
The source identifies chiral GC or HPLC, but the product-specific method remains in unassociated SI.

regions.region: upper two-column bibliography continuation, References [17]-[21], with otherwise blank page
regions.finding: The page contains bibliography and software citations only. No reaction arrow, experimental procedure, table row, mechanistic experiment, synthetic outcome, or standalone characterization peak list is present; no reaction record was created.
